title: Anchor for VP06. Standing in the basin west of the origin; the camera grazes the water toward the far shore.
note: Named states double as the viewpoint anchors in tools/harness/viewpoints.json: shoot.mjs calls loadState(viewpoint.anchor) before posing the camera, so every anchor id MUST be a loadable state or the viewpoint is unshootable and the metric it feeds scores 0, fail-closed (HARNESS.md §6). | W1-01: `showcase: true` keeps this anchor on W1-00's 420 m origin neighbourhood. HARNESS.md §6 poses for VP01-VP12 are absolute and within 130 m of the world origin, and the world origin is 250 m out in the Topal Bay, so the province cannot host them without changing a pose — which HARNESS.md §6 says invalidates every cross-wave comparison. The province has its own viewpoint set: tools/harness/viewpoints-province.json.
